<!-- pr-reviewer: dd45a6c4099528c87c382bb31e004d0b25643a05 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (after #640, which it is stacked on).

Reviewed only `dd45a6c4`. The two earlier commits (`c7ab1602`, `53e4aebb`) are #640's; there are no merge commits in the stack. Trial merge with upstream/main is clean ("already up to date").

**What looks good**
- `lathe_stroke::judge` runs only on lathe-kind machines (`lathe_stroke.rs:48`). It judges `posting::nose::posted_path`, the control-point stream the post receives, and falls back to the nose-centre cache only when the post refuses the orientation, so no op goes unjudged.
- X is the signed meridian radius, read as `radiusOf` reads it: world X if Y is on the axis, Y if X is on the axis, with the 0.0005 tolerance (`:92-107`). A point past centre is negative and meets the -2.5 floor, so a facing to centre fits. Both the X band and the Z band are judged.
- Arcs about the spindle axis are judged on their radius, with quarter points. A point off every meridian is judged three ways (signed X, radius, Y), and NaN fails every band. Over-reporting is the safe direction.
- The refusal wording is unchanged ("<op>: move i reaches v in X, the stroke is lo..hi").
- Mill and mill-turn paths are untouched: `mod.rs` skips the world-X block only when `judge` returned true.
- The new tests fail without the fix: facing below the floor and a turning pass past the X ceiling are both refused by name, and a guard sits on the band edge. The updated expectation (Rough1 at Z 634.200, the control point) is explained, and the mill-turn expectation still reads 635.000.
- The decision record is present.

**Local results (merged with main, own target)**
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post --no-run` | builds |
| lathe_stroke | 10 passed |
| lathe_cross_drill / field_sim / field_tools / nose_tip / post_g76 / post_refusals / post / spindle_fit / spindle_keyed / spindle_law | 5 / 6 / 2 / 6 / 5 / 5 / 7 / 3 / 6 / 8 passed |
| turning, turning_axial_rapids / blade / bore / bore_feeds / contour / contour_stock / form / holder / insert_zone / profile / stock_approach / thread | 5, 3 / 14 / 11 / 3 / 10 / 3 / 8 / 8 / 5 / 6 / 3 / 8 passed |
| machine / machine_edit / machine_library | 32 / 12 / 11 passed |
| `--lib machine` | 6 passed |
| posting / conformance / golden_cl | 17 / 6 / 23 passed |
| clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post --all-targets -D warnings | clean |

`lathe_thread_travel` is not on main yet (#643), so it could not be run. No goldens change in `dd45a6c4`; the golden edits in the PR belong to #640.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. `crates/app/src/machine/mod.rs` is now 427 lines (was 418), already over the ~400 target. The lathe judge is split out, but the file grew by 9; worth shrinking later.
2. As the body says, #643's `lathe_thread_travel` fixture says `"min": 0.0` against #640's -2.5 floor. Whichever of #643 and #640 merges second updates that string, and #643's `spindle_arc` branch becomes unused on lathes.
3. This should wait for #640 to merge, and #640 should be the base when it does.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
